task_name: World 120 Task B  -  Prepaid Vendor Advance vs. Unscheduled Insurance, Negative AP Sign, Equipment Loan Split & Paid Receipt Cutoff
prompt: Perform a comprehensive B2B SaaS Deferred Revenue Ratable Recognition, Prepaid Amortization & Loan Amortization Split review using the world files (`northstar_oct2026_saas_prepaid_and_loan_close.xlsx`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.

rubric.description: Retains BILL-4402 / PAY-4402 ($16,800.00 under PO-719 for 2026-11-25 tooling delivery) in 1350 Prepaid Expenses as a verified provisional paid vendor advance ($0.00 October expense) with a bounded 2026-11-30 true-up check.

Refuses to accept the preparer's vendor_advance workpaper tag on CHK-5108 ($14,400.00 Sentinel Specialty Insurance) and holds $14,400.00 as an unscheduled insurance policy with unmeasured 2026-10 amortization rather than inventing an unsupported 12-month schedule without the declaration page.

Reconciles 2000 Accounts Payable at $32,230.00 net ($38,650.00 open bills on BILL-4410 plus -$6,420.00 negative balance on CloudScale Hosting Inc. from unapplied payment PAY-3912) and refuses to reclassify -$6,420.00 to 1350 Prepaid Expenses from negative AP sign alone.

Splits equipment loan payment CHK-7820 ($4,365.00 booked to 6320 Equipment Loan Expense under statement STM-LN-7820-202610) into $3,620.00 principal reduction ($118,400.00 opening less $114,780.00 ending principal) and $745.00 interest expense, reconciling 2620 Equipment Notes Payable to $114,780.00.
Provides the correcting journal entry for CHK-7820: Dr 2620 Equipment Notes Payable $3,620.00, Dr 7110 Interest Expense $745.00, Cr 6320 Equipment Loan Expense $4,365.00.

Excludes paid corporate card receipt PUR-8904 ($8,750.00 Stratos Security Labs, already paid 2026-10-26 and booked in 6410 Security Testing Expense) with $0.00 accrual so a paid receipt in the close folder is never double-accrued.

Accrues unpaid October legal invoice BILL-4490 ($5,400.00 received 2026-11-03 for 2026-10 MSA redlines) via Dr 6420 Legal & Professional Fees $5,400.00 and Cr 2110 Accrued Expenses $5,400.00 (paired with a 2026-11-01 reversal of $5,400.00), yielding a net +$1,780.00 pre-tax expense increase from measured adjustments prior to pending CHK-5108 policy-declaration amortization.

Discloses the $14,400.00 unscheduled CHK-5108 policy declaration hold and the -$6,420.00 PAY-3912 missing-bill investigation with 2026-11-30 true-up triggers, reports close disposition as closed with estimates rather than certified under POL-PREPAID-AP, and never credits 1350 Prepaid Expenses for unpaid accruals.
